author: EnchantedSwords
body:
IGN: EnchantedCombo (JasperRekveld on the moment I was banned)

I have been banned from the server for the reason: Anti-Knockback

I should be unbanned because I wasn't hacking. My internet dropped out, so my minecraft froze. (Sometimes when people's internet drop out they stand still and take 0 kb. That's what happened to me.)

The reason I make this unban so long after my ban is: I never knew how to appeal before. I have been playing on other servers for a long time and then some of my friends found out about this server, I really want to play with them because at this moment I can't because I'm banned :(. I don't have any evidence that I don't hack, but I can assure you I wasn't hacking. 

If you still think I was hacking I would like to see the evidence of me hacking that got me banned.

Thank you for reading this and I hope I get unbanned soon! 

EnchantedCombo

replies.body:
Hello,

Because you have been banned for quite a long time, in addition to lack of evidence, I will appeal your infraction and give you the benefit of the doubt. However, if you are banned again, your chances of becoming unbanned will decrease to a minimal, if not 0%.

Regards,
Dutchis
Avicus Network Administrator
